brief: A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.

requirements.requirement: Herb planter of three cells side by side
requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases in a row at 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 2,0,0 joined and capped, with bins planted with basil-young, mint-young, rosemary-young

requirements.requirement: Each with a bin that drains
requirements.evidence: Each cell holds bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain – full-depth drained bins, filled with soil

finish.summary: Three-cell linear planter built with drained full-depth bins, soil filled and planted with three herbs, joints locked and caps fitted.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
